"""Capture bounded development-command identity, timing and exact output."""
import asyncio,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp,Stopwatch
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor,CommandOutputPolicy,CommandStdout,CommandStderr
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git
R=Path.cwd();O=Path(__file__).parent
async def main():
 name=sys.argv[1];args=sys.argv[2:];assert args
 tracked=await git(R,'ls-files','-z',trim=False)
 untracked=await git(R,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z',trim=False)
 paths=sorted(set((tracked+'\0'+untracked).split('\0'))-{''})
 selected=[p for p in paths if (p.startswith(('src/','tests/','apps/','scripts/')) and not p.startswith('tests/experiments/')) or p in ['pyproject.toml','uv.lock','.python-version','AGENTS.md','.gitignore','.gitattributes']]
 before={p:hashlib.sha256((R/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in selected}
 started=str(Timestamp.now());timer=Stopwatch()
 (O/(name+'-intent.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(name=name,command=args,started_at=started,head=await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD'),tree=await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),inputs=before),indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 execution=CommandExecutor(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=16<<20,max_stderr_bytes=4<<20)).start(Command(args[0]).args(*args[1:]).cwd(resolve_path(R)))
 with (O/(name+'.live')).open('wb') as live:
  async for event in execution.events():
   if isinstance(event,(CommandStdout,CommandStderr)):live.write(event.data);live.flush()
 result=await execution
 timer.stop();after={p:hashlib.sha256((R/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in selected}
 (O/(name+'.stdout')).write_bytes(result.stdout);(O/(name+'.stderr')).write_bytes(result.stderr)
 value=dict(name=name,command=args,started_at=started,finished_at=str(Timestamp.now()),seconds=timer.elapsed.total_seconds,exit_code=result.exit_code,head=await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD'),tree=await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),inputs=before,inputs_unchanged=before==after,stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),stderr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest(),stdout_truncated=result.stdout_truncated,stderr_truncated=result.stderr_truncated,events_dropped=result.events_dropped)
 (O/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');assert before==after
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in value.items() if k!='inputs'},indent=2));print(result.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-2200:]);print(result.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-1000:])
asyncio.run(main())

"""Run original public consumers at exact original blobs, restoring our own delta."""
import asyncio,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor,CommandOutputPolicy
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp,Stopwatch
R=Path.cwd();O=Path(__file__).parent
async def main():
 paths=['apps/qwen/model_tool_composition.py','apps/qwen/context_tools.py','apps/qwen/commands.py'];ours={p:(R/p).read_bytes() for p in paths}
 assert not await git(R,'diff','--cached','--name-only');start=str(Timestamp.now());timer=Stopwatch()
 try:
  for p in paths:
   old=await git(R,'show','HEAD:'+p,trim=False);(R/p).write_bytes(old.encode('utf-8'))
   assert await git(R,'hash-object','--path='+p,p)==await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD:'+p)
  before={p:hashlib.sha256((R/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
  result=await CommandExecutor(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=8<<20,max_stderr_bytes=2<<20)).execute(Command('uv').args('run','pytest','--no-cov','tests/apps/qwen/test_context_tools.py','tests/apps/qwen/test_coding_loop.py','tests/apps/qwen/test_check_bundle.py','tests/tools/test_execution.py','-q').cwd(resolve_path(R)))
  assert before=={p:hashlib.sha256((R/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
  (O/'baseline-original.stdout').write_bytes(result.stdout);(O/'baseline-original.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr);timer.stop()
  v=dict(started_at=start,finished_at=str(Timestamp.now()),seconds=timer.elapsed.total_seconds,head=await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD'),original_blobs={p:await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD:'+p) for p in paths},physical_inputs=before,exit_code=result.exit_code,qualification='Prior baseline was invalidated by concurrent source edits and is not credited. This run restores the exact original application blobs only in their canonical paths, then restores our owned delta in finally. New framework module is present but unreferenced by these original consumers.')
  (O/'baseline-original.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(v));print(result.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-2400:])
 finally:
  for p,b in ours.items():(R/p).write_bytes(b)
asyncio.run(main())

"""Retain literal output from the maintained application-isolated host."""
import asyncio,json,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor
O=Path(__file__).parent;R=Path.cwd();HOST=R/'tests/agents/native_tool_host.py'
async def main():
 rows=[]
 for scenario in ['success','unauthorized','arguments','stale','foreign-source','missing-id','duplicate-id','check-failed','cancel-admission','lost-result','cancel-effect','tool-exception','partial-batch']:
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-independent-host-') as directory:
   result=await CommandExecutor().execute(Command(sys.executable).args('-B',str(HOST),scenario).cwd(resolve_path(directory)))
   assert result.exit_code==0,result.stderr.decode();row=json.loads(result.stdout);assert row['usage'] is None and row['denied']==['import:apps','file:apps/qwen/tasks.py']
   row['command_exit']=result.exit_code;rows.append(row)
 value=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),runtime=sys.version,rows=rows,qualifications=['Real framework-only child processes in separate authored temporary repositories, no copied project source.','Guard controls attempt forbidden imports/opens and are denied before application content is loaded.','EffectTool is an independent test fixture, not a promoted editing engine.'])
 (O/'host-outcomes.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(scenarios=len(rows),success=rows[0],all_command_exits=0),indent=2))
asyncio.run(main())

"""Exact scope, independent old-oracle preservation, custody and link checks."""
import asyncio,ast,hashlib,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git
from scripts.backlog.intake import Intake
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp
R=Path.cwd();O=Path(__file__).parent
async def main():
 s=json.loads((O/'initial-state.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));base=json.loads((O/'pr-47-accepted.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['main'];assert await git(R,'rev-parse','HEAD')==base
 assert not (R/'.local/backlog/checkout-owner').exists() and not await git(R,'diff','--cached','--name-only')
 changed=set((await git(R,'diff','--name-only')).splitlines());unknown=set(filter(None,(await git(R,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z',trim=False)).split('\0')))
 assert {p for p in unknown if p.startswith('experiments/')}=={f['path'] for f in s['forensics']}
 for f in s['forensics']:assert hashlib.sha256((R/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
 for p in ['tests/apps/qwen/test_context_tools.py','tests/apps/qwen/test_check_bundle.py','tests/models/interaction/test_tools.py']:
  old=ast.parse(await git(R,'show',base+':'+p));now=ast.parse((R/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'));before={n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in old.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))};after={n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in now.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
  assert all(after[k]==v for k,v in before.items()),p
 assert not await git(R,'diff','--','apps/qwen/tasks.py','apps/qwen/coding_loop.py','apps/qwen/turns','apps/qwen/obligations','apps/qwen/edits.py','apps/qwen/continuation.py','apps/qwen/change_checks.py','apps/qwen/development_task.py','src/devtools/models','src/devtools/tools/execution.py','src/devtools/tools/disclosure.py','src/devtools/execution','src/devtools/persistence','scripts','experiments','tests/experiments','pyproject.toml','uv.lock','AGENTS.md')
 core=ast.parse((R/'src/devtools/agents/model_tools.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));imports=[n.module or '' for n in ast.walk(core) if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom)];assert not any(x.split('.')[0] in {'apps','scripts','experiments'} for x in imports)
 facade=ast.parse((R/'apps/qwen/model_tool_composition.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert not any(isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name=='normalize_tool_descriptor' for n in facade.body)
 links=0
 for p in ['src/devtools/agents/docs/model_tools.md','src/devtools/tools/docs/overview.md','apps/qwen/README.md']:
  d=R/p
  for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',d.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
   rel=unquote(target.partition('#')[0]).strip('<>')
   if re.match(r'[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:',rel):continue
   assert (d.parent/rel).resolve().exists(),(p,target);links+=1
 q=Intake(R).queue();assert not q['errors'] and len(q['proposals'])==s['intake_chains'];ledgers={};rows=0
 for name in ['ri-completion-experiments.jsonl','ri-completion-fixtures.jsonl','ri-followup-history.jsonl']:
  p='docs/research/code-audit/'+name;h=await git(R,'rev-parse',base+':'+p);assert await git(R,'hash-object','--path='+p,p)==h;rows+=sum(1 for x in (R/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if x.strip() and json.loads(x));ledgers[p]=h
 assert rows==903;await git(R,'diff','--check')
 value=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),base=base,changed=sorted(changed),new=sorted(unknown-{f['path'] for f in s['forensics']}),original_existing_test_function_ASTs_unchanged=True,legacy_normalizer_is_direct_reexport=True,unchanged_task_lifecycle_authority_and_validation_owners=True,local_links=links,intake_chains=len(q['proposals']),forensics=13,RI_rows=rows,RI_ledger_blobs=ledgers)
 (O/'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(value,indent=2))
asyncio.run(main())
